2. Cart → Shipping Handoff

Existing /cart continue CTA must enter /shipping.

Before rendering Shipping:

load current authoritative Cart

reject empty/expired cart

validate cart still belongs to current guest/customer

do not trust cart totals from client

preserve current cart identity/version semantics

If cart changed/stale:

use stable localized error/state

no raw status/JSON

3. Saved Address Selection

For authenticated customer:

load real saved addresses

display current human labels

support selecting one

current selected address persists through refresh/back according to checkout state

no address GUID displayed

For guest:

use current guest checkout/address mechanism

do NOT invent customer-account address book behavior

Address selection must feed shipping eligibility/calculation.

4. Add New Address

Connect the existing آدرس جدید UI.

Reuse existing Tooba Dialog/form patterns.

Required fields according to current domain/configuration, including as applicable:

recipient full name

mobile

province

city

full address

postal code

Rules:

use real province/city data source if current system has one

no fake hardcoded test lists in production path

validation backend-authoritative

localized errors

saved-address creation for authenticated customer only if current product semantics already allow it

guest address remains checkout-scoped if that is current model

Do not add unnecessary fields.

5. Recipient Information

The اطلاعات تحویل گیرنده section must reflect the selected/new address.

Preferred behavior:

prefill from selected address

allow only fields current business rules permit to differ from address

do not duplicate address entry unnecessarily

Recipient data must be snapshotted into checkout/order through existing domain path.

No UI-only state as final source of truth.

6. Store-Enabled Shipping Methods — CRITICAL

The visible shipping-method cards must be loaded from REAL Store/Admin configuration.

Do not hardcode:

پست

ارسال اکسپرس

دریافت حضوری
or any method merely because Shopeiva template contains them.

Only methods that are:

enabled for current Store

valid for current destination

valid for the cart's sellers/offers/items

operational under current configuration

may be selectable.

Use existing Shipping Provider Registry where applicable.

Human localized labels only.

If zero methods are available:

show a professional localized empty/unavailable state

disable continue

no fake fallback method

7. Multi-Seller Shipping Eligibility

Cart may contain Offers from multiple Sellers.

The checkout shipping projection must account for seller-specific constraints.

Do not assume all Sellers have identical shipping capability.

For each candidate customer-facing shipping option, backend must determine whether the cart can actually be fulfilled with that selection according to current architecture.

Important:
This task is NOT Consolidated Package work.

Do not expose Admin fulfillment concepts in Storefront.

If a single customer-facing method results in multiple Seller Shipments internally, that is acceptable if current shipping orchestration supports it.

No cross-module SQL shortcuts.

8. Shipping Price — Backend Authoritative

Shipping cost displayed in /shipping must come from backend calculation/configuration.

Forbidden:

static Shopeiva amount

frontend-computed authoritative rate

always-free fallback

hardcoded price per method

Shipping total must flow into checkout/order summary using the canonical pricing/checkout calculation path.

Cart product totals from T001 must remain unchanged except where canonical checkout calculation legitimately adds shipping.

Explicitly test:

shipping paid

shipping free only when actual rule/config says free

multiple sellers

selected method changes shipping amount

currency/Rial-Toman display correctness

9. Minimum Delivery Time — LOCKED PRODUCT RULE

User requirement:

The earliest delivery must be based on what the Seller can actually prepare plus the selected shipping method.

Customer may choose a later valid delivery date/time.
Customer may NEVER choose earlier than the calculated minimum.

This rule must be backend-authoritative.

Determine from existing domain/configuration:

Seller handling/preparation time

Offer/item readiness if relevant

Store/business calendar if available

shipping method transit/lead time

cutoff time if available

delivery-slot constraints if available

Do NOT invent complex calendar infrastructure if absent.

Use the smallest correct existing model.

Multi-Seller rule

For a cart with multiple Sellers, the customer-visible earliest delivery for the selected shipping option must not be earlier than the slowest required seller/item readiness plus applicable shipping lead time.

No seller may be promised before its minimum readiness.

Document exact formula chosen.

Evidence:
docs/evidence/TB-P10-T002/delivery-minimum.md

10. Delivery Date / Time UI

Preserve the existing Shopeiva زمان تحویل section.

The date cards/options must be real.

Required:

dates before minimum are not selectable

earliest valid date is clear

later valid dates may be selected

if more dates exist than visible template cards, extend using the existing visual interaction pattern; do not redesign

selected date persists in checkout state

Time selector:

show only valid windows at or after minimum constraints

earlier invalid windows disabled/omitted

if no slot model exists and only estimated-day delivery exists, do not fabricate hourly slots; adapt minimally using the existing UI contract and document the limitation

No client-only validation; backend must reject an earlier forged date/time.

11. Order Notes

Connect existing optional توضیحات سفارش.

Requirements:

optional

trim/length validation

persisted in checkout/order using existing note field intended for customer delivery/order note

do not route into internal Admin note semantics

localized errors

12. Checkout Shipping State Persistence

Selection must survive:

refresh

navigating back to /cart

returning to /shipping

supported guest/session continuity

Persist through existing checkout/cart/order-draft mechanism.

Do not store authoritative shipping price/time only in React state/localStorage.

If selected address/method becomes invalid after refresh:

backend revalidates

UI requires reselection with clear message

13. Continue CTA

Existing ادامه به پرداخت button:

Enabled only when required Shipping step is valid:

valid address/recipient

valid shipping method

valid delivery date/time according to current capabilities

current cart still valid

On click:

persist authoritative shipping selection

proceed to existing /payment

T003 will connect Payment.
Do NOT implement payment methods in this task.

The /payment route may remain existing/template-backed, but Shipping must hand off correct real checkout state.

14. Security

Required:

customer cannot use another customer's saved address without authorization

guest checkout address bound to its guest checkout/cart ownership

no cross-store address/shipping configuration leakage

no trusting client-supplied shipping price

no trusting client-supplied earliest date

no client spoof of disabled method

Store/Tenant context authoritative

Use existing 404/security conventions where appropriate.

15. Error UX

destination unsupported

no shipping methods available

cart changed

delivery date too early

delivery slot no longer available

seller/item temporarily unavailable

No raw:

provider code

stack trace

JSON

HTTP status text

Use centralized Storefront error mapping.

16. Performance

N+1 shipping method labels/translations

repeated quote recalculation loops

Prefer coherent Shipping checkout projection containing:

selected address

eligible methods

shipping price

earliest delivery

available delivery options

checkout summary

according to current architecture.
